mapper.select: SELECT FROM partners ORDER BY created_at DESC, id DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO partners (code, name, type, contact_person, phone, email, address, active) VALUES (#{code}, #{name}, #{type}, #{contactPerson}, #{phone}, #{email}, #{address}, #{active})
